morphology_rules: Cranial and facial ridge architecture is the dominant species-readable feature.
A central forehead structure recurs while temple, orbital and cheek ridge topology varies by individual.
Ridge continuity may extend through jaw and neck.
Neck surface relief/patterning is a prominent recurring anatomical cue.
The supplied references show pale grey, beige and brown-grey surface presentation with individual and lighting variation.
Hair remains an individual presentation layer rather than part of the ridge identity.
identity_rules: Cranial, facial and neck ridge topology belongs to persistent individual morphology.
Later portraits must preserve the same ridge map and underlying facial identity.
Hair, clothing, role and political affiliation may change independently.
cultural_separation: Do not infer Cardassian Union loyalty from anatomy.
Do not encode cruelty, military status or intelligence-service affiliation into neutral portrait design.
forbidden: one prosthetic ridge map across all Cardassians
occupation-era political identity inferred from species
facial expression used as loyalty shortcut
